<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ndiff(fr1,fr2):
    b=fr1.ascii.split('\n'); a=fr2.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if b[r][c]!=a[r][c])
def ppos(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'):
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return out
before=current_frame

print('MOUSE(33,33) ndiff',ndiff(before,current_frame),'player',ppos(current_frame))
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
